summary: Tabs feature implemented but not run: tests were not executed, per instructions. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text; Opacity now merges blended color into existing style, preserving click metadata; new tests/test_tabs.py and new UnderlineBar tests; new docs/reference/tabs.md. The layout resolver was not changed because its Edge protocol already has size, min_size and fraction. Choices: the bar position uses the displayed-tab index rather than the find_tab_by_name index, so duplicate names still put the underline under the displayed tab; key search applies to any non-digit key string, not only single characters; click names are not escaped; the optional sandbox demo was skipped. Nothing was committed.
